newsitem.title: USA: Aquila buys Cheaspeake, Union Pacific natgas.
newsitem.headline: Aquila buys Cheaspeake, Union Pacific natgas.

text.p: Aquila Gas Pipeline Corp said Thursday that it is purchasing and gathering natural gas from the two largest horizontal natural gas wells ever drilled and completed onshore in the U.S.
The purchase price of the gas was not disclosed.

The company said the Union Pacific Resources Group Inc Eberle 1 well, completed March 25, flowed in excess of 80 million cubic feet per day and the Chesapeake Energy Corp Brown 1-H well, finished March 29, flowed at 100 million cubic feet per day. Both wells are in Washington County, Texas.
The company added that a third well in the area, Union Pacific's Schwickert 1, which has tested at a rate of 16 million cubic feet per day, will be connected shortly to Aquila's gathering system.
